title: The identifiers of the surfaces frames are handed to
description: Written by the running sketch just after launch, when the display output lives in another process. A reader looks the surfaces up by identifier and takes the one whose mokume.frame attribute is largest (ADR-0032 decision 3). The contents change only when the size changes; this is not written per frame.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. How it is raised is ADR-0018 decision 5.

ids.description: The surface identifiers (IOSurfaceGetID). The order is the order they are written in. There is more than one so that a half-written frame is never handed over.

width.description: The surface's width in pixels. The same as the drawing resolution, with no bars included.

height.description: The surface's height in pixels. The same as the drawing resolution, with no bars included.
